text:
devin: Heads-up — we're getting a handful of 413s from customers hitting the vectors endpoint with mixed-dim payloads. Current API requires a single dim per request, but some SDKs are batching different models together. Do we want to: enforce server-side reject (keep current), auto-split by dim, or accept mixed dims and pad/encode?

maya: I saw those 413s too. Rejection is simplest and keeps runtime fast. But lots of users expect client SDK to batch heterogeneous models.

sam: Can we cheaply detect mixed dims and route to a splitter service that fans out? That keeps runtime simple but adds routing cost.

leah: SDKs already do some heuristics but not everywhere. If we add server-side splitting we need quota implications: do we charge by original payload size, per-subrequest tokens, or by final tokenized bytes?

devin: Good point about billing. Proposal A: reject with 413 + helpful error explaining supported shapes and a link to migration guide. Proposal B: server-side split + charge per subrequest. Proposal C: accept mixed by padding to max dim and bill by padded size (simpler for routing but could be abuseable). Thoughts?

maya: I'm leaning to A for now with improved error + explicit console telemetry showing "mixed_dim_attempts" so we can measure. We can do B as a follow-up if enough demand.

sam: For B, routing policy needs to consider shard placement. If we split and route subrequests to different GPU types (quantized vs full), we might violate latency SLOs. Would need a small state machine: split -> route to same-node pool if possible -> else fallback. Complexity spikes.

infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: canary rollout for /vectors-splitter v0.1 started on eng-prod-small-202.

leah: Also telemetry — we need per-tenant metrics: attempted_mixed_dim_count, successful_auto_splits, avg_extra_latency_ms. Console needs a per-route toggle to opt-in to server-side splitting (off by default).

ops: From ops perspective, A is safest. 413s + clear message reduce support load. But we should ship a small UX: in the console route settings show a banner and a one-click toggle: "Allow mixed-dim auto-splitting (beta)" with explicit cost estimate.

devin: Implementation checklist if we do A now + telemetry:
- return 413 with body: {
  "error": "mixed_dims",
  "message": "All vectors in a request must have the same dimension. See https://docs.redwood.ai/vectors#mixed-dims for migration steps."
}
- emit telemetry event: vectors.mixed_dim_attempt (tenant, model_variants, count)
- console: add sampled logs and UI row showing top offending clients

maya: For the docs, include client-side sample to split payloads. Example:
```json
POST /v1/vectors
{
  "inputs": [ {"id":"a","vector":[...],"dim":512}, {"id":"b","vector":[...],"dim":768} ]
}
```
And show helper pseudo: `sdk.splitByDim(inputs).forEach(chunk => client.vectors(chunk))`

sam: If adoption forces B later, we should design the splitter interface now as a separate service behind the router so the runtime stays dumb. That reduces risk. Also add a header `X-Vector-Split: planned-v1` so we can trace when splitter touched requests.

leah: Quotas — leaning to charging based on post-split tokens (sum of subrequests). Otherwise clients could smuggle extra dims and pay less if we charged by input count. Need finance sign-off but seems fair.

devin: Agree. For now we'll: ship A + telemetry + console flag to request enabling beta splitting (manual enable per-tenant via support). Backend work for B will be a separate project with routing/placement review.

maya: I'll draft the 413 error text and docs. Sam can prototype splitter service interface and a canary. Leah will own telemetry metrics and console row. Ops will coordinate the support flow for tenant opt-ins.

ops: Sounds good. Please add staging tests to ensure no regression for existing single-dim batches.

devin: One more thing — think about the embedding model catalog: we should expose "native_dim" in model metadata so routers can detect compatible variants and avoid padding. Add to model manifest: `native_dim: 768`.

sam: Good call. That also helps for smart routing (route 512 inputs to 512-optimized kernels).

leah: I'll add telemetry label `model.native_dim` to the mix.

infra-bot: deploy-bot posted: /docs update PR created: refs/changes/embeddings-mixed-dims-error-413

maya: OK shipping plan: A (error + docs + telemetry) -> 1wk -> show console stats -> iterate on B if uptake > 5% mixed attempts in two weeks.

devin: Thanks all. I'll create the RFC and tasks.

leah: Quick optional: include a small sample Grafana panel JSON in the docs showing mixed_dim_attempts over time — helps SRE and PMs discuss.

sam: Will prototype the splitter API: POST /internal/v1/vectors/split -> returns [subreq_ids] and header `X-Split-Latency-ms`.

devin: File issues and link here. Closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
